section.34: The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten

34.name_native: The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten

hadiths.text: Ibn 'Umar reported that a person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was sitting on the pulpit about the eating of the lizard, whereupon he said:I neither eat it, nor do I prohibit it
